capture_provenance: User-supplied native captures plus explicitly identified headless replays of unchanged installed UI bytes. Replay service data/preferences are synthetic and native effects are inert.

desktop_constraint: User-approved headless browsers and CPU renders only; no physical mouse/keyboard input, foreground activation, installation or real-host cleanup.
acceptance_rule: An action closes only with recorded source state, exact control, resulting state/dialog/artwork, cancel/back/error branches, and matching DCleaner interaction evidence. Screenshot presence and static REA alone never close it.
